municipalDifferences.resolution: Preserve the MOIS active-ri exclusion count of 62. Both sources agree exactly on the 26 canonical dong/eup/myeon and 27 administrative relations; do not add a ri route.

sourcePriority: Current MOIS full official relationship dataset retained; fresh municipal summary exactly corroborates canonical units and relationships.
